answer: Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A voyage of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
